messages:
alyssa: heads up — we had a question from legal about linking rollout IDs into exported audit bundles. they want a reliable way to trace who changed a routing policy during a canary.
mike: got it. is the ask about UI linking or the raw export payload? :thinking:
alyssa: both. they want console links in the presigned bundles and a compact ndjson field with rollout_id + actor + reason.
jun: the export shape today has actor/timestamp/action but not rollout_id or route_snapshot_id. adding rollout_id seems low-risk.
elena: small note: rollout_id can be ephemeral for short-lived canaries. we should also export the commit_hash or policy_version to be deterministic.
young-sre-bot: Deploy notifier: canary-rollout/8923 started by @sam in prod-us-east at 2024-11-02T09:12:23Z
sam: ^^^ that's the rollout. legal wants that 8923 visible in downloads so they can match to retention requests.
mike: API debate: add a new optional field `event_context` with arbitrary tags (rollout_id, commit, tenant_hint) vs adding first-class `rollout_id` field. thoughts?
jun: prefer explicit `rollout_id` top-level. easier to query and enforce indexing for exports.
elena: indexable fields > arbitrary tags for compliance consumers. also: add `sourcing_route_snapshot` with compact diff hash so we can prove "what changed".
alyssa: UX: show a small inline "View rollout" link in the download modal that opens console to that rollout. fallback to show commit if rollout removed.
sam: permissions: only users with `audit:download` + tenancy role should get presigned link. export should include an `authorized_by` and `export_request_id` fields.
mike: quotas: large export generation should count against tenant export_quota and increment async job cost. add telemetry metric `audit.export.size_bytes` and `audit.export.rollout_tagged`.
jun: for backwards compatibility, we'll keep old ndjson field names and add `rollout_id` + `policy_version` as new fields. we should version the export schema (v2) and surface in download headers.
elena: opt-in toggle in console? some customers may not want rollout linkage to avoid extra PII mapping. need admins to opt-in per-tenant.
alyssa: decision summary: add top-level rollout_id + policy_version + export_request_id; include console link in modal; telemetry metrics + quota charge; admin opt-in toggle; v2 schema header. who's picking the PRs?
sam: i'll take the console modal + permission bits.
mike: i'll spec the export schema + backend tagging and metrics.
jun: i'll add the db column for rollout_id and ensure indexing.
elena: i'll draft the opt-in privacy text and update legal on retention implications.
alyssa: awesome. can we have a short RFC/PR by EOD Friday? tag with `#audit-exports-rollout` in PRs.
sre-bot: Reminder: please add unit tests for export schema changes and ensure NDJSON consumers still parse v1 (compat mode).
alyssa: thanks all :thumbsup:
